start: Money, a gym with receipts this month by cash and UPI and some unpaid plans

user_sees: Page "Money" with "Every rupee that came in" and the tabs "Collections" and "Dues"
A "Period" row: "Today", "Last 7 days", "This month", "Last month", "This financial year", "Custom"
must_not: A period that shows receipts dated outside it

user_sees: "How it came in" with one line per payment method and its amount
The receipts list for the month, with the filters "All methods" and "Everyone"
must_not: A cancelled receipt inside the collected total
The methods not adding up to the total
A summary that counts other receipts than the list shows

user_sees: "All money still due to the gym"
Tiles "Total due", "Over 60 days", "31–60 days", "Up to 30 days", "Not started yet", each with an amount
"Who has dues" with "Filter by how long it is due", each member with "Collect"
must_not: A plan that starts in the future shown as overdue
An archived member who owes money missing from the total
A cancelled plan chased as a due

steps.action: Tap "Download Excel file" on "Who has dues"
user_sees: A file <gym>-dues-<today>.csv with only the rows on screen
Toast "Exported <n> dues." (or "Exported 1 due.")
must_not: A file with more rows than the filtered list
Amounts in paise instead of rupees

start: A link straight to the Dues tab (/money/dues), for example from a dues number on Today

user_sees: Money opens on "Dues", not on "Collections"
must_not: The Collections tab shown first
A blank page

user_sees: The collect-fees sheet for that member; if the member cannot be opened: "That member could not be opened. Try reloading the page."
must_not: The sheet of another member
An amount of zero when dues exist

start: Money on a new gym with no payments and no unpaid plans

user_sees: "Nothing collected in this period" and "No receipts here"
"Download Excel file" is greyed out
must_not: NaN or "₹NaN" as an average or largest receipt
A download of an empty file

user_sees: "No dues" with "Every membership is fully paid." and the button "Open Members"
must_not: Empty age tiles with a download button

steps.action: Pick "Custom" and set the from-day after the to-day
user_sees: The two days are read the right way round, or a plain message
must_not: A crash or a minus total

start: Money, This month, with one receipt just taken

steps.action: Cancel that receipt from its receipt page, then open Money again
user_sees: The collected total and its method line are lower by that amount; the cancelled money is shown apart
must_not: The cancelled receipt still in the total
The receipt gone with no trace

user_sees: The member owes that amount again, in the age group of the plan start day
must_not: The member still shown as paid

user_sees: The member is still in the list and in "Total due"
must_not: The dues total dropping because a member was archived

start: Money on the owner login; then the same gym on a front desk (staff) login

steps.action: As owner, filter receipts by "Everyone" then by one staff name
user_sees: Only receipts taken by that person, and a summary for the same receipts
must_not: Receipts of another gym or branch

user_sees: Only "Dues", titled "Who still has fees to pay", with no tabs
must_not: The Collections tab, "Total due", the age tiles or "Download Excel file" shown to staff

start: Money on a front desk (staff) login, with members who owe fees

user_sees: Page "Money" with "Who still has fees to pay"
"Who has dues" with "Filter by how long it is due" and each member with what they owe and "Collect"
must_not: Any gym-wide total
The Collections tab

steps.action: Tap "Collect" on a member and take the fee
user_sees: The collect sheet for that member; after saving, the member leaves the list or shows the smaller amount
must_not: The member still listed with the old amount
The receipt saved without the name of who took it

start: A link to the Collections tab (/money/collections) opened on a staff login

user_sees: The Dues list, as from the menu
must_not: The collections report shown for a moment before it changes
An error page

start: Money on a staff login when nobody owes anything

user_sees: "No dues" with "Every membership is fully paid." and "Open Members"
must_not: A blank page
A money total of zero shown as a tile

steps.action: Pick an age filter with nobody in it (when some dues exist)
user_sees: "Nothing in this age group"
must_not: The list of another age group

start: Money on a staff login, a member with a part-paid plan

steps.action: Collect part of what is owed
user_sees: The member stays in the list with the smaller amount
must_not: The member gone though money is still owed

user_sees: The member leaves the list
must_not: The member listed with "₹0"

steps.action: Look for a way to cancel the receipt just taken
user_sees: No cancel for staff: only the owner cancels receipts
must_not: Staff able to undo money

user_sees: Names and what each member owes
must_not: "Total due", the age tiles with amounts, "Download Excel file" or any figure of all money collected
